title: Promote bootstrap roster and finding registry into authoritative ledger
description: Carry the versioned primitive roster, canonical audit-finding subject table, and real source-anchor/projection-absence evidence model from the bootstrap ledger into the clause-complete authoritative ledger. Preserve exact membership diffs and fail-closed evidence resolution rather than copying snapshot counts.
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative ledger imports or formally supersedes bootstrap-capability-roster-v1; every authoritative primitive has source-backed membership and no synthetic absence proof; bootstrap-to-authoritative diff is executable and reviewed.
close_reason: ADR-0020 disposition pass 2026-09-22 (eshyra-o9bd.19 rebaseline): RETIRED - orphaned child of the DESIGN_INVALIDATED bootstrap ledger (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1, PR #477 closed unmerged). It requires a positive semantic-absence proof, a closed projection-shape registry for absence proofs, the unmerged bootstrap-capability-roster-v1, or the pre-F1 obl::: identity, all of which rest on the global negative claim ADR 0020 withdrew. Replacement: none needed for the claim; bounded backlog reconciliation was delivered by eshyra-olc5.5 (PR #545) and the capability contract by eshyra-olc5.6. No importer or state defect is owned here.
